notes: Four-lane parallel sweep (ai / bigtech+hardware+mobile / devtools+cloud / security) via background subagents, ~140 queries total, every lane hitting DNS/EGRESS blocks on direct vendor-domain WebFetch and falling back to WebSearch. The big news of the day was Apple's 'Pro and Tell' event: the existing forward-looking placeholder for 2026-10-28 ('Apple launches refreshed M6 MacBook Pro') turned out to be only half right, so it was corrected rather than replaced — the M6 MacBook Pro (non-touch, $1,999) and a refreshed M6 iMac actually shipped quietly on 2026-10-27, while the headline reveal on 2026-10-28 was a new touchscreen MacBook Pro on M5 Pro/M5 Max, filed separately. Alphabet's Q3 2026 placeholder was upgraded from 'expected' to confirmed actuals (revenue +25% to $127.6B, Cloud +103% to $30.7B) via its own SEC 8-K. Reconfirmed the src/lib/id.ts 60-character slug truncation bug flagged in prior run logs (2026-10-25/26/27): titleTokens() on 'OpenAI retires GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini from the API' produces a stray fragment token ('f') because slugify() slices the whole string to 60 chars before tokenizing, cutting off mid-word inside 'from'.
